officialExamsAudit.notes: Comprehensive, clean, and authentic archive of Algerian BAC exams with official stream metadata.

sciences_exp.qualityNotes: Exceptional pedagogical depth. All 31 skills have verified lessons, step-by-step worked examples, practice MCQs, cognitive repair guides, isomorphic retests, and past BAC citations.

math.qualityNotes: High rigor. Math Batch 01 packages cover congruences, Bézout, complex numbers, TVI, and differential equations.

technique_math.qualityNotes: Shared technical core with Math & Sciences.

gestion_eco.qualityNotes: CRITICAL FLAW: 32 bundles exist in code, but their MCQ options fall back to synthetic strings ('خيار بديل opt_b', 'الإجابة الصحيحة', 'إجابة خاطئة شائعة'). Unusable for real student testing.

lettres_philo.qualityNotes: CRITICAL BLOCKER: 23 skills are defined in the taxonomy, but getSkillLearningBundle returns null for 100% of them. Any mission launched in this stream results in 'Mission introuvable'.

langues_etrangeres.qualityNotes: CRITICAL BLOCKER: 0 authored learning bundles. Completely inaccessible for students.

sciences_exp.assessment: SUFFICIENT (Reliably identifies student weaknesses across core math/physics/science axes)

gestion_eco.assessment: SUFFICIENT (Covers accounting, economics, and quantitative foundations)

lettres_philo.assessment: SEVERELY DEFICIENT (3 questions cannot provide valid diagnostic insights)
